title: crypto2dev: ECDSA sign/verify/keygen callbacks
description: Implement CryptoCb handlers for ECDSA P-256 and P-384 operations using KEY fds. Sign: retrieve KEY fd from key->devCtx, call DO_SIGN ioctl with pre-hashed digest, read DER signature into wolfSSL output buffer. Verify: retrieve KEY fd, call DO_VERIFY ioctl, map -EBADMSG to ECC_BAD_ARG_E or equivalent. Keygen: open fd, KEY_GENERATE('ecdsa(p256)' or 'ecdsa(p384)'), read public key (uncompressed point), populate ecc_key. Key import: write raw private scalar, KEY_IMPORT. Key free: close KEY fd, zero devCtx.
notes: ECC sign callback receives pre-hashed digest in 'in' field — no hash type field in struct, infer from digest length (32=SHA256, 48=SHA384). DER-encoded signature from DO_SIGN maps directly to wolfSSL's expected DER output. P-521 not supported by crypto2dev — return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE for it.
